newsitem.title: USA: Applied Industrial sets 3-for-2 stock split.
newsitem.headline: Applied Industrial sets 3-for-2 stock split.

text.p: Applied Industrial Technologies said Friday its board has declared a three-for-two stock split payable on September 15 to shareholders of record on August 29.
On September 15, stock certificates for one additional common share for every two shares held will be issued, it said.
Fractional shares will not be issued but will be paid in cash, it said.
After the stock split, the company will have about 22.0 million shares outstanding, it said.

Applied Industrial, with fiscal 1997 sales of $1.16 billion, is an independent distributor of bearings, mechanical and electrical drive systems, industrial rubber products, fluid power components and specialty maintenance and repair products.
